description: This organization's own recent download attempts, newest first, REFUSALS INCLUDED - a denial carries the `outcome` and `http_status` that answer "it stopped working", which nothing else here can. Use it to explain a failing fetch, to confirm a transfer ran, or to check whether a request was theirs. This is a bounded WINDOW of at most 200 rows, so a database missing from the answer means it is not in this window - never that it was never downloaded.

limit.description: How many attempts to return, newest first. At most 200; the API defaults to 50.

name: list_downloads

items.description:
One download ATTEMPT, refusals included - a denial is what answers "it
stopped working", so they are listed rather than dropped.

apikey_id.description:
The key that made the request. Null when the org acted through the
console rather than through a key.

bytes.description:
Object size at redirect time, NOT bytes delivered: the transfer is a
presigned redirect straight to object storage, so we never observe it.
int64 for the same reason as DatabaseFormatSize.bytes - it is the
size of the same object.

sample.description: The evaluation sample rather than the database itself.

title: List recent download attempts
